text: When Hari Shankar [moves into an abandoned palace in Allahabad|trigger|making a new home], the old gardener tells him of Kamini, who waited each midnight for a lover who drowned one stormy night. A [photograph falls from the bedroom wall|images|pictures, screens and recordings], and the man in it has Shankar's face. A woman's singing draws him through the empty rooms, and she tells him that by [entering the body of another woman|wants|a way into life] she could live again. Even after he marries Ranjana, he [slips away every night to meet her|wrong|love betrayed].
